description: Agent Memory: submit a memory setup: the agreement (when the principal is asked whether to be remembered: before anything is kept, only after memory has started, or never; how agreement is given: an explicit opt-in, a default the principal can turn off, a line in the terms or none; the categories it covers; whether it is recorded), the principal’s controls (whether they can see, correct and switch off what is kept on their own, only by asking or not at all, whether switching off stops new writes and whether what is kept is then cleared, left to the principal or kept), and optionally the categories actually kept. The signed report says whether the principal agreed to be remembered, what the agreement covers and whether they can see, correct and switch off what is kept, and names no agreement, memory kept before the principal was asked, agreement as a line in the terms, every category kept beyond the agreement, no way to switch memory off and writes that continue after it is switched off, then memory on by default, an unrecorded agreement, every control only on request or missing and memory kept after switching off, with the fix for each. This reads whether the principal agreed and stays in control: what the system keeps at all is wever_memory-scope-check, whether one sharing event of live context needs consent is wever_context-sharing-check and whether a removal request clears memory everywhere is wever_memory-deletion-check. Verdict remembered_without_consent, consent_gaps, consent_unverified or principal_in_control. POST /api/memory-consent-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-memory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-memory/.

asked.description: When the principal is asked whether to be remembered: before anything is kept, only after memory has started, or never.

covers.description: The categories the agreement covers, such as preferences and task history.

form.description: How agreement is given: an explicit opt-in, a default the principal can turn off, a line in the terms, or no agreement.

recorded.description: The agreement is recorded with when it was given and what it covered.

correct.description: How the principal corrects what is kept: on their own, by asking, or not at all.

on_switch_off.description: What happens to what is already kept when memory is switched off: it is cleared, the principal chooses, or it is kept.

see.description: How the principal sees what is kept: on their own, by asking, or not at all.

stops_writes.description: Switching memory off stops new writes at once.

switch_off.description: How the principal switches memory off: on their own, by asking, or not at all.

kept.description: The categories actually kept, to compare with what the agreement covers.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

principal.description: Who is remembered, such as the traveler.

system.description: The agent, such as the travel assistant.

name: wever_memory-consent-check
title: Memory consent check
